name: Vollebak
why: Graphene, aerogel, Dyneema — clothes from the future, sold as materials demos.
origin: Twin brothers Nick and Steve Tidball, London, 2016 — advertising creatives turned materials-science clothiers.
opview: “Clothes from the future” — their stated project.

onething.p: For When All Hell Breaks Loose Jacket

notes.tech: names no technology and holds the dial anyway: the material is the name. Graphene, aramid, ceramic, aerogel and copper garments, with Dyneema and Schoeller licensed alongside
notes.synth: engineered materials as the entire catalog
notes.avant: avant-garde in material rather than form — graphene and aerogel as statements
notes.weird: jackets for Mars, hoodies you can bury in the garden
